description: Plan and understand your equity compensation with Secfi. Get answers on your portfolio valuations, exercise costs, AMT exposure and model exit scenarios - all calculated from your actual equity data. Weather you’re trying to decide when to exercise or stress-testing potential exit outcomes, the analysis comes to you from Secfi’s calculation APIs.
